confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are triangulated from several third-party Gothenburg sources (cost-of-living aggregators, Expatistan, Cities Insider, bar listings). Many are undated or crowdsourced and they disagree, so treat them as bounded estimates. SEK figures were converted at about 9.7 SEK per USD, a rate implied by the dollar-kronor pairs in those sources, not a live lookup. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation search was run and no live listings were checked. FX is secondhand: the 0.6976 value for 2026-11-03 was reported in a market commentary, I did not open the RBA page or the F11.1 table, and the observation is about two weeks older than the 2026-11-19 generation date. Verify it against the RBA daily table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gothenburg-specific food and drink sources, cross-checked against Swedish cost levels (one aggregator puts Gothenburg about 7% above the Swedish average). Accommodation is a holistic estimate loosely benchmarked to mid-sized Western European cities with similar summer demand.
